BackstoryDef.title: terratech ambassador
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an ambassador of their tribe, keeping relationships stable between their tribe and other factions. Their tribe's unique technology would often get the attention of others, and it was [PAWN_nameDef]'s job to make sure they didn't become belligerent or pry too much.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech caretaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of maintaining terratech productions. [PAWN_objective] job was to make sure armories were always stockpiled, revitializing assets when they were near expiry, and tending to the remains of whatever eventually withered away.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech sleeper agent
BackstoryDef.description: Terratech tribes need to make sure they are prepared for being attacked, and [PAWN_nameDef]'s job was instrumental in providing advantages. Alongside other sleeper agents, [PAWN_objective] had to always be ready to form rebel cells that would disrupt and weaken the colony [PAWN_nameDef] was infiltrating. This job was very sensitive and demanding, severely impacting any connections with others, and forcing them to work within the shadows.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech crop tender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed giant, complex fields of various terratech creations, constantly harvesting weapons and materials, and rotating them on a strict schedule. Even during the least demanding times, [PAWN_possessive] job required her to manage dozens upon dozens of individual, unique crops.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech geosmith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent most of their life around <color=#D46F44>Lithic-class</color> materials and items. Many of these items required constant upkeep, and [PAWN_nameDef] not only made sure each weapon reached it's highest evolution, but also made sure each one performed to their expectations.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech inquisitor
BackstoryDef.description: Regardless of safety protocols, terratech assets will eventually end up in the wrong hands. Whenever this happened, [PAWN_nameDef] was sent out to retrieve the contraband, and dispose of anyone that was in [PAWN_objective] way.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech scribe
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a terratech scribe, one of the most honored roles within the culture. [PAWN_objective] was in charge of keeping and passing down closely-guarded secrets, and defending them to their last breath.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] was also trained in combat, as the threat of being captured for interrogation always loomed above their heads.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an alchemist of [PAWN_pronoun] tribe, primarily in charge of medicines and foods. [PAWN_pronoun] both tended to any that needed care, and produced poisons - and their antidotes - whenever necessary. [PAWN_nameDef] also acted as an infusion specialist, combining terrasaps with weapons.

BackstoryDef.title: terrathyst miner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked deep below the surface, seeking out and mining deposits of terrathyst. [PAWN_pronoun] spent far more time mining stone than terrathyst, as the job was more about asset denial than production. Still, [PAWN_pronoun] job was quite valued, and every deposit found resulted in praise and celebration.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech evolutionist
BackstoryDef.description: Being products of nature, every Terratech weapon has infinite potential, and [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of pushing this science. Their knowledge of Terratech bioengineering, particularly in weapons, is unmatched.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech battleheart
BackstoryDef.description: Terratech tribes are often targets of raiders - and even high-tech colonies - due to their powerful items, secretive technology, and the assumption that rejection of standard technology made them easy targets. [PAWN_nameDef]'s job was to fight off anyone who dared attacking - and [PAWN_pronoun] become very good at their job due to how often this happened.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech bloomcarver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up working around woods that were almost exclusively used to create furniture and decor. Thus, [PAWN_pronoun] mastered manual artistic and crafting skills, both of which were generally handled by specialized seeds.\n\nThis skill allowed them to become the go-to artist of multiple nobles and royals across the tribes, as their creations were unique symbols of status that seeds could never replicate.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech chef
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed the cooking of their tribe, an underappreciated - and vital - role. As the beliefs on eating fruits and vegetables from the earth varied between tribes, [PAWN_possessive] job also included handling livestock.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech seaworker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] mostly worked away from their tribe, diving deep into the oceans to seek out the lost aquatic terratech that are documented to once exist. They were rarely successful, almost always finding decayed remains and destroyed ruins buried in the ocean floor.\n\nDue to their extensive travelling, they picked up many tricks regarding building structures wherever they went, whether that was on the surface, within caves, or even within the ocean.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech outsider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was not born into the tribe, or brought in via cultural beliefs. Rather, [PAWN_pronoun] was allowed into the tribe as an adult, and proved [PAWN_possessive] worth through extreme trial. In particular, their construction skills was seen as valuable, as the tribe's reliance on grown structures can sometimes backfire.\n\nDespite their effort and willingness, [PAWN_pronoun] was treated more like a slave than an equal; they were untrusted, untrained in weapon handling, was forbidden from forming intimate relationships, and access to tribe technology was far out of [PAWN_nameDef]'s reach.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech outsider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was not born into the tribe, or brought in via cultural beliefs. Rather, [PAWN_pronoun] was allowed into the tribe as an adult, and proved [PAWN_possessive] worth through extreme trial. In particular, their medical skills was seen as valuable, as the tribe can generally hold off threats, but larger raids can result in relatively overwelming injuries.\n\nDespite their effort and willingness, [PAWN_pronoun] was treated more like a slave than an equal; they were untrusted, untrained in weapon handling, was forbidden from forming intimate relationships, and access to tribe technology was far out of [PAWN_nameDef]'s reach.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech outsider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was not born into the tribe, or brought in via cultural beliefs. Rather, [PAWN_pronoun] was allowed into the tribe as an adult, and proved [PAWN_possessive] worth through extreme trial. In particular, their crafting skills was seen as valuable, as the tribe's reliance on grown weapons and tools can backfire during droughts or in unfertile regions.\n\nDespite their effort and willingness, [PAWN_pronoun] was treated more like a slave than an equal; they were untrusted, untrained in weapon handling, was forbidden from forming intimate relationships, and access to tribe technology was far out of [PAWN_nameDef]'s reach.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech spaceworker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a part of a secretive tribe that lived in space, maintaining and guarding the remnants of terratechnologies that utilized the sun and stars. These assets were incredibly desired by pirates and others who would discover their existence, and demanded [PAWN_nameDef] to be highly skilled in combat and negotiation.

BackstoryDef.title: grovetender
BackstoryDef.description: Throughout immense trials, conflict, and ambition, [PAWN_nameDef] was voted to lead of the few Terratech factions on the planet. [PAWN_pronoun] serves as the leader for the entire tribe, spending much of their life going from village to village, making sure the integrity terratech factions have held throughout history remains strong. [PAWN_pronoun] serves the most vital role in the faction, though it is custom to make sure another is ready to take [PAWN_possessive] place in the case of capture, or untimely death.\n\nDespite their high position they still partake in everyday tasks, working alongside the workers of the tribe.
